info.description:
Open research platform for computational rare-disease work. Research and hypothesis generation
only: nothing served here is clinical advice.

Every error is problem JSON (`application/problem+json`). Aggregated responses carry
`sources: SourceStatus[]`, so a page renders when one upstream source is down. Writes need the
`X-Helix-Workspace` header (an anonymous ID generated by the client).
info.title: Helix API

post.description: Events: `status` (thinking, answering), `tool_call` and `tool_result` (one per lookup), `segment_delta` (index, kind, delta) while the answer is written, `answer_reset` when a partial answer is discarded, `answer` (the validated AssistantAnswer), `error` (code, message) and `done`. Only `answer` is authoritative: segment labels in `segment_delta` are the model's own and have not been checked yet.
